name: law-firm-system
description: 律所闭环管理系统 - Law Firm Management System

scripts.build:all: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.security:test: node --test scripts/security/policy.test.mjs scripts/security/audit-gate.test.mjs scripts/security/process-runner.test.mjs scripts/security/artifacts.test.mjs scripts/security/cli.test.mjs scripts/security/dependency-contract.test.mjs
scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix apps/server ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm --prefix apps/server run db:generate
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/server run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/server run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/server run test:unit && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix apps/server run test:unit && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm --prefix apps/server run check:baseline && npm run check:bootstrap && npm run build
